items.title_en: Ex-IT employee turns Bengaluru auto driver, says she now earns more
items.title_zh: 前 IT 员工转为班加罗尔汽车司机，表示她现在收入更高
items.summary_en: Digital content creator Tanvi later shared the interaction on Instagram, where the woman spoke about her career change, family circumstances, and the reasons behind her decision to leave IT and become an auto driver.
items.summary_zh: 数字内容创作者 Tanvi 随后在 Instagram 上分享了这次互动，这位女士谈到了她的职业转变、家庭情况以及她决定离开 IT 并成为一名汽车司机的原因。

items.title_en: Canadian man flags Bengaluru’s broken footpaths, cracked pavements: ‘Like asteroid collided with Earth’
items.title_zh: 加拿大男子标记班加罗尔破损的人行道和破裂的人行道：“就像小行星与地球相撞一样”
items.summary_en: The Canadan vlogger questioned how such conditions could persist in one of Bengaluru’s prominent neighbourhoods, particularly in a city widely regarded as one of India’s technology and startup hubs
items.summary_zh: 这位加拿大视频博主质疑这种情况如何在班加罗尔的著名街区之一持续存在，特别是在一个被广泛认为是印度科技和创业中心之一的城市

items.title_en: Gandhi Jayanti getaway turns nightmarish: Tourists sleep on roads, massive jams at Rishikesh, Shimla, Nainital
items.title_zh: 甘地·贾扬蒂的度假变成了噩梦：游客睡在路上，瑞诗凯诗、西姆拉、奈尼塔尔严重拥堵
items.summary_en: Gandhi Jayanti weekend rush leaves Manali, Shimla, Nainital and other hill stations gridlocked, with tourists facing traffic jams and hotel shortages.
items.summary_zh: 甘地·贾扬蒂周末高峰导致马纳里、西姆拉、奈尼塔尔和其他山地车站陷入拥堵，游客面临交通拥堵和酒店短缺的问题。
